name: Zivko Edge 540
summary: Single-seat all-composite unlimited aerobatic monoplane used in the Red Bull Air Race and in airshow and competition flying.

wings: Thin, straight mid-set carbon-composite wing with a symmetrical section
engines: Six-cylinder Lycoming AEIO-540 in a tight cowl
fuselage: Single seat under a large bubble canopy
Fixed spring-composite gear with a tailwheel
tail: Large rudder and fin on a sleek tapering tail

tellTales: Single-seat taildragger with a large bubble canopy and three-blade prop
Thin, straight composite wing with huge ailerons
Smooth all-composite fuselage and tight engine cowl

confusedWith.howToTell: Most Extras are two-seaters with a long canopy and a fabric-covered rear fuselage; the Edge 540 is a single-seater with an all-composite smooth fuselage.
The XA42 is a two-seater with a longer canopy; the Edge 540 is a single-seater.
The Pitts is a biplane; the Edge is a monoplane.
